properties.name: UserSecretsId
properties.doc: The id of the user secrets store of the project (dotnet user-secrets).

properties.name: PreserveCompilationContext
properties.doc: Keep the reference assemblies for compiling at run time (Razor runtime compilation).

properties.name: AddRazorSupportForMvc
properties.doc: A Razor class library with MVC views and Razor Pages.

properties.name: RazorLangVersion
properties.doc: The version of the Razor language.

properties.name: StaticWebAssetBasePath
properties.doc: The URL prefix of the static web assets of a Razor class library; _content/<PackageId> by default.

properties.name: SpaRoot
properties.doc: The folder of the single-page application of the project.

properties.name: SpaProxyServerUrl
properties.doc: The URL of the front-end development server.

properties.name: SpaProxyLaunchCommand
properties.doc: The command that starts the front-end development server, e.g. npm start.

properties.name: TypeScriptCompileBlocked
properties.doc: Leave the TypeScript files to the front-end tooling.

properties.name: RunAOTCompilation
properties.doc: Compile a Blazor WebAssembly application ahead of time on publish.

properties.name: BlazorWebAssemblyLoadAllGlobalizationData
properties.doc: Load the ICU data of every culture.

properties.name: BlazorEnableTimeZoneSupport
properties.doc: false: drop the time zone data from a Blazor WebAssembly application.

properties.name: OpenApiGenerateDocuments
properties.doc: Generate the OpenAPI documents of the application during the build.

properties.name: OpenApiGenerateDocumentsOnBuild
properties.doc: Generate the OpenAPI documents on every build.

properties.name: OpenApiDocumentsDirectory
properties.doc: Where the generated OpenAPI documents go.

properties.name: OpenApiGenerateDocumentsOptions
properties.doc: Options of the document generator, e.g. --file-name my-api.

items.name: OpenApiReference
items.doc: An OpenAPI document a typed client is generated from during the build.

metadata.name: Namespace
metadata.doc: The namespace of the generated client.

metadata.name: ClassName
metadata.doc: The class name of the generated client.

items.name: OpenApiProjectReference
items.doc: A web project whose OpenAPI document a typed client is generated from.

metadata.name: Namespace
metadata.doc: The namespace of the generated client.
